mapper.insert: INSERT INTO production_task (user_id, template_id, status, stage, created_at, updated_at, version) VALUES (#{userId}, #{templateId}, #{status}, NULL, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, 0)

INSERT INTO production_task_asset (task_id, position, asset_id) VALUES
(#{taskId}, #{asset.position}, #{asset.assetId})
mapper.sql: pt.id, pt.template_id, mt.title AS template_title, mt.cover_url AS template_cover_url, pt.status, pt.stage, pt.result_url, pt.failure_code, pt.failure_reason, pt.created_at, pt.started_at, pt.completed_at, pt.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM production_task pt JOIN material_template mt ON mt.id = pt.template_id WHERE pt.id = #{id} AND pt.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT pt.id, mt.result_url FROM production_task pt JOIN material_template mt ON mt.id = pt.template_id WHERE pt.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE production_task SET status = 'PROCESSING', stage = #{stage}, started_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'QUEUED' AND stage IS NULL

UPDATE production_task SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', result_url = #{resultUrl}, failure_code = NULL, failure_reason = NULL, completed_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND stage = #{expectedStage}

UPDATE production_task SET status = 'FAILED', stage = #{stage}, failure_code = #{code}, failure_reason = #{reason}, completed_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND stage = #{stage}

UPDATE production_task SET status = 'FAILED', stage = NULL, failure_code = #{code}, failure_reason = #{reason}, completed_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'QUEUED' AND stage IS NULL
